q: Besides sending messengers, what else did Sennacherib do to mock the LORD, the God of Israel?
a: He wrote letters mocking the LORD

q: When the Assyrians called out to the people of Jerusalem on the wall, what was their purpose?
a: To frighten and terrify them in order to capture the city

q: When the Assyrians threatened Jerusalem, which prophet joined King Hezekiah in crying out to heaven in prayer?
When Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem humbled the pride of their hearts, what was the result during Hezekiah's days?
a: The wrath of the LORD did not come upon them

q: In 2 Chronicles 32, where was Hezekiah buried when he died?
a: In the upper tombs of David’s descendants

q: How old was Manasseh when he became king?
Where did Manasseh build altars to all the host of heaven, in both courtyards?
a: In the house of the LORD
